errors.text: The specified AuCoCuNiPt nanoparticles are replaced with CoCrFeMnNi or unspecified refractory alloys, eliminating the Au/Cu surface-segregation and evaporation physics central to the target.

The predicted grain coarsening and secondary-phase formation do not reconstruct the observed particle loss, Au/Cu shell formation, evaporation-driven size reduction, and elliptical-to-spherical reshaping.

The cited evidence does not directly support accelerated diffusion or thermal instability in sub-10 nm HENA particles: E1 is a general HEA review statement, E2 concerns magnetic phase stability, and E3 concerns nanowire mechanics.
